answer_1.quote: We assess the performance on downstream tasks using multiple-choice benchmarks. We choose natively curated benchmarks in their respective languages to avoid translation artifacts.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers to multiple-choice and generative math questions in the target language, conditioned on few-shot prompts.
